about: The rules register (Tzvi, 12 Nov 2026: rules as a building blueprint). One record per rule: how it is built (KIT starter code, GEN a script from the blueprint answers, ASK one blueprint question, OWNER the owner message, EYE the final review), what builds it, what confirms it. status built = a starter part does it today; planned = still to build. A new rule is added here with its building part the same day (check-rule-homes).

rules.built_by: Phase 4: python scripts/check-light-pool.py <photo> prints the ground spread; CONCEPT.md - light: line

rules.rule: A choice (3ai.2): live art drawn in code behind the words, seeded from the business's name, quieter on phones, still under reduced motion
rules.built_by: Phase 5 - treatments: line picks it; to build: a starter part kit.live_art(seed, colours) that does the seed, the phone and the reduced-motion versions

rules.rule: Every scroll film has a scroll timeline: a scroll line per chain.json step (start and end in the scroll, what moves, when its words come and go)
rules.built_by: Phase 5 writes the timeline with the sketch sheet; phase 6 copies it into gen/chain.json as each step's scroll line
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: the scroll lines against the opening at 20, 50 and 80 percent

rules.rule: BRAND.md has a ## For ads part, and every ad for the business names it (ad step A27.1)
rules.built_by: Phase 3 writes BRAND.md with its ## For ads part; ad-blueprint stage 1 asks for it (A27.1)
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK on the site side; scripts/ad-blueprint.mjs BRAND_RULES on the ad side

rules.rule: Prices and order controls stay calm: no tilt, 3D, parallax or scroll effect on them
rules.built_by: The starter's price row, stepper and Add carry no transform or scroll effect; the build adds none

rules.rule: Each clip's end still made first with the room for the words named in its prompt; a light-only clip says static locked-off camera
rules.built_by: The film brief: each clip's end still is generated first, its prompt naming the words' room; clips where only light moves carry the locked-camera phrase
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: each end still and its prompt in the brief

rules.rule: The scroll film eases its playback rate down onto a sharp resting frame, never a hard stop or a freeze
rules.built_by: The film's last clip ends on a sharp frame chosen in the brief; to build: film.js eases the rate down at the end
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: the opening scrolled to its end, laptop and phone

rules.rule: Every played clip has a poster, no sound, a phone version, WebM with MP4 fallback where the starter plays a file; the headline is real HTML
rules.built_by: starter film.js and slides.js set muted and a poster on every video; encode makes the phone version; to build: a WebM copy beside the MP4
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: network panel and the page with video off

rules.rule: The - motion: line gives durations, distances or scales, stagger, what waits until the previous step has settled, and alignments in pixels
rules.built_by: The page plan writes CONCEPT.md - motion: with numbers (3e.16c, 3al.4)
rules.confirmed_by: node scripts/check-compared.mjs <build> (MOTION: three numbers with units) + LOOK

rules.rule: Each scroll-tied effect planned as three pictures on the design board: start, midpoint, end
rules.built_by: The design board gets a start, midpoint and end picture for each scroll-tied effect before it is built
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: the three pictures beside the effect at 0, 50 and 100 percent

rules.rule: BRAND.md ## Image style pasted at the end of every image prompt; one image model per set; one change per edit
rules.built_by: BRAND.md is written with its ## Image style paragraph; every image brief ends with it
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: BRAND.md and the end of each prompt

rules.rule: The split opening, branching hero, layered parallax, video-to-layers handoff, panel wipe and light switch are menu choices counted in 3ai's three, by category fit
rules.built_by: The - treatments: line picks from the menu of 3ai, which lists them

rules.rule: Intros on the first visit only and a few seconds long; none on menu, prices or shop pages; parallax off on phones
rules.built_by: The page plan puts intros on the home page only; to build: the starter remembers a first visit and turns parallax off under (hover: none)
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: second visit, shop and menu pages, phone

rules.rule: Before a risky change the builder writes back what it understood; each section built from its own reference picture, still first, motion second
rules.built_by: SKILL.md's build step names both habits

rules.rule: A clip whose camera travels gets a grey-shape camera rough before it is paid for; its prompt is written second by second from the rough
rules.built_by: Blender or a three.js grey-box page recorded with Playwright (section 8, job 4) writes gen/board/rough-<step>.mp4; the brief writes the prompt from it
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: the rough beside the clip, on part D of the board

rules.rule: A film behind feature words leaves one half clear for the words, the subject crossing for the next feature
rules.built_by: The film brief: each end still names the half left clear
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: the opening at each feature, laptop and phone

rules.rule: The picked first screen and the part C home page carry the tweaks panel for Tzvi
rules.built_by: scrollcraft/starter/tweaks.js copied into gen/board/
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: the panel on the picked first screen

rules.rule: Exploded view, growing card, paper-cut scene or two-axis chooser only when picked, labels from the owner, never near prices or on shop pages
rules.built_by: Picked on CONCEPT.md treatments or signature lines

rules.rule: Our own reviews on the site say what a real site order was (item names only) with Order this; nothing for other reviews; hidden with none
rules.built_by: scrollcraft/starter/reviews.js; the API adds ordered and order_again (routes/reviews.py _attach_ordered)

rules.rule: After Send on a laptop, a QR code of the same WhatsApp message for the phone
rules.built_by: scrollcraft/starter/qr.js loaded before shop.js
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: a test order on a laptop, scanned with a phone

rules.rule: The wheel scrolls with weight on a laptop (off on touch and reduced motion)
rules.built_by: scrollcraft/starter/site.js smooth-scroll block, kept in every build

rules.rule: No row of equal boxes for facts or steps, no grid of equal photo tiles; product cards stay equal
rules.built_by: Section plan writes facts and steps as ruled rows, a band or one per screen, and past work as a collage

rules.rule: A choice: the next section slides over the last (data-over), a plain stack on a phone
rules.built_by: Picked on the treatments line; built per site
rules.confirmed_by: LOOK: scrolled slowly on a laptop and a phone

rules.rule: At most one self-moving strip of real facts, data-strip, paused on hover, still with reduced motion
rules.built_by: Picked on the treatments line; built per site

rules.rule: A film opening arrives in steps within 2 s before any scroll: picture fades in and settles, headline rises in
rules.built_by: scrollcraft/starter/site.css .film .stage arrival

rules.rule: The section after the scroll film slides up over its last picture on a laptop (data-over), never a plain cut
rules.built_by: scrollcraft/starter/site.css .film + [data-over], film.js ends the film a screen early

rules.rule: When picked, the page lifts off a fixed footer holding the closing name (.foot data-lift), laptop only
rules.built_by: scrollcraft/starter/site.css .foot[data-lift]

rules.rule: Controls answer in 300 ms or less, ease out, never from scale(0), no bounce, pressed buttons shrink to 0.97
rules.built_by: The starter's control transitions (160 ms) and :active scale(.97); a site's own effects keep to it

rules.rule: Long names, four-digit prices and a missing photo never break a card or scroll the page sideways
rules.built_by: Cards wrap their names, prices sit in their own row, photo boxes have a fixed shape

rules.rule: Motion planned in five moments (opening in order, cards in turn, chooser swap, sheet grow, Add pop); hover only on mouse devices
rules.built_by: Phase 5 writes CONCEPT - motion:; built within 3e.16b's limits

rules.rule: The opening is dramatic and premium and opens on an event; its type is chosen per business (staged product, film, light reveal, split opening, parallax, live art), never one look for all
rules.built_by: The three first screens are three different opening types; Tzvi picks one; its pictures are made after the pick
